description: Security settings card showing two-factor methods with status badges and setup actions.

import { KeyRound as KeyRoundIcon, MessageSquare as MessageSquareIcon, ShieldCheck as ShieldCheckIcon, Smartphone as SmartphoneIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" const methods = [ { icon: SmartphoneIcon, name: "Authenticator app", detail: "Added Sep 3", enabled: true, }, { icon: KeyRoundIcon, name: "Security key", detail: "Use a hardware key like a USB token", enabled: false, }, { icon: MessageSquareIcon, name: "SMS backup", detail: "+44 •••• ••• 482", enabled: true, }, ] export default function TwoFactorSecurityCard() { return ( Two-factor authentication Your designali account is protected with 2 methods. {methods.map((m) => (
{m.name} {m.detail}
{m.enabled ? ( On ) : ( )}
))} ) }
